purpose: Every standalone Towns & Towers mushroom-fields fantasy piece and the complete CTOV mushroom village, with mine and well donors, for selecting the Mushroom catalog.
worldNote: Placed in the trio test world east of the Savanna gallery, with the void biome filled through every row's sky so lightning cannot strike.
selectionRule: Every standalone piece of the T&T mushroom-fields fantasy village and its outpost tower, entity-only animal templates omitted; every standalone CTOV mushroom piece, roads omitted and entities stripped, with other mods' blocks shown as neutral vanilla markers; the ten original Village Life mines and the D&T miner compound; the D&T, Terralith and T&T classic wells. Street, terminator and villager templates are omitted.
